sections.title: باب 1 — متن (21)

paras.text: … selection is made by the Prime Minister. These posts include ambassadors, military generals, members of the Public Service Commission, chairmen of various autonomous institutions and provincial governors etc. Now the name of the Chief Election Commissioner is sent to a parliamentary committee by the Prime Minister and the Leader of the Opposition. In the same way, after the end of the government, the power of nominating the caretaker government also belongs to the Prime Minister and the Leader of the Opposition. The Prime Minister is directly the leader of the people. He belongs to the largest political party of the country and his roots are in the people. The President is generally an impartial personality above politics who keeps national interests in view and does not directly take part in political matters. It can be concluded that the real moving leader of the country is the Prime Minister, who is the true representative of the people. The President is the ceremonial head of the State. In this way, from the constitutional point of view, the Prime Minister has superiority in the country’s politics.

paras.urdu: پولیس کی ذمہ داریاں (Responsibilities of Police)

paras.text: The police is an important branch of government, and it has been given the basic responsibility of establishing law and order within geographical boundaries. In Pakistan the police has several powers and duties or responsibilities. Basically the work of the police is the establishment of law and order inside the country. However, when the situation goes out of the control of the police, the government can call paramilitary forces or the army to help the police. The police is trained to combat unrest. It is the responsibility of the police to trace terrorist groups and forces spreading unrest and bring them to justice. The protection of the life and property of the people is an important responsibility of the police. The police takes criminals into custody and presents them in court for punishment. Gambling, drinking, drug dealing, theft, murder, dacoity, kidnapping, hoarding and black marketing etc. are crimes for whose control the police is responsible. The police generally keeps a complete record of criminals. Finding out their centres and groups is the responsibility of the police. In this way uprooting crime and establishing law and order is the first responsibility of the police. For the control of traffic a branch of the police works under the name of Traffic Police. The Traffic Police challans vehicles on violation of law and presents them in court. Through the media this branch creates awareness of traffic laws among the people …

… selection is made by the Prime Minister. These posts include ambassadors, military generals, members of the Public Service Commission, chairmen of various autonomous institutions and provincial governors etc. Now the name of the Chief Election Commissioner is sent to a parliamentary committee by the Prime Minister and the Leader of the Opposition. In the same way, after the end of the government, the power of nominating the caretaker government also belongs to the Prime Minister and the Leader of the Opposition. The Prime Minister is directly the leader of the people. He belongs to the largest political party of the country and his roots are in the people. The President is generally an impartial personality above politics who keeps national interests in view and does not directly take part in political matters. It can be concluded that the real moving leader of the country is the Prime Minister, who is the true representative of the people. The President is the ceremonial head of the State. In this way, from the constitutional point of view, the Prime Minister has superiority in the country’s politics.

Responsibilities of Police

The police is an important branch of government, and it has been given the basic responsibility of establishing law and order within geographical boundaries. In Pakistan the police has several powers and duties or responsibilities. Basically the work of the police is the establishment of law and order inside the country. However, when the situation goes out of the control of the police, the government can call paramilitary forces or the army to help the police. The police is trained to combat unrest. It is the responsibility of the police to trace terrorist groups and forces spreading unrest and bring them to justice. The protection of the life and property of the people is an important responsibility of the police. The police takes criminals into custody and presents them in court for punishment. Gambling, drinking, drug dealing, theft, murder, dacoity, kidnapping, hoarding and black marketing etc. are crimes for whose control the police is responsible. The police generally keeps a complete record of criminals. Finding out their centres and groups is the responsibility of the police. In this way uprooting crime and establishing law and order is the first responsibility of the police. For the control of traffic a branch of the police works under the name of Traffic Police. The Traffic Police challans vehicles on violation of law and presents them in court. Through the media this branch creates awareness of traffic laws among the people …

sections.heading: باب 1 — متن (22)
sections.text:
شعور اُجاگر کرتا ہے۔ ڈرائیونگ لائسنس کا اجراء، سڑکوں پر آمدورفت اور امن و امان قائم کرنا، حادثات کی روک تھام اور جائے حادثات تک پہنچنا، سڑکوں پر گشت کرنا اور چوکیوں میں ڈیوٹی دینا پولیس کی ذمہ داری ہے۔ شہروں میں ٹریفک کے مسائل حل کرنے کیلئے منصوبہ بندی کرنا اور ٹریفک قوانین کا اِحترام کروانا پولیس کی ڈیوٹی ہے۔ گاڑیوں کی قانونی حیثیت معلوم کرنے کیلئے اِس کے اپنے سائنسی تحقیقی مراکز ہیں۔ ہر اہم سڑک اور چوک میں پولیس کے جوان عوامی خدمت کیلئے تیار کھڑے رہتے ہیں۔ اگر پولیس یہ ذمہ داری انجام نہ دیتی تو نہ جانے روزانہ کتنے حادثات ہوتے رہتے اور کتنی غیر قانونی اور مجرمانہ آمدورفت ہوتی رہتی۔

ضلعی سطح پر پولیس کے دو شعبے ہوتے ہیں:

۱۔ تفتیشی شعبہ (Investigation Branch)

۲۔ عملیاتی شعبہ (Operational Branch)

۱۔ تفتیشی شعبہ:

پولیس کا یہ شعبہ مقدمات تیار کرتا ہے۔ ہر ضلع میں اس کا اپنا ایک سربراہ ہوتا ہے۔ یہ شعبہ تھانوں میں درج مقدمات کو عدالت میں پیش کرنے کیلئے تیار کرتا ہے۔ عدالت اور پولیس کے درمیان خط و کتابت اور مقدمات کا ریکارڈ رکھنا اِس برانچ کی ذمہ داری ہے۔ یہ شعبہ مقدمات کی تیاری میں پولیس کے دوسرے شعبہ کے ساتھ رابطے میں ہوتا ہے۔ اہم اور …
